Initial release: Instantly generate vertical hydraulic-press crushing short videos from text or images.

- Converts user requests for crushing videos (e.g., lipstick, marbles, gadgets) into full vertical short clips with expanded, production-ready prompts.
- Enforces detailed prompt expansion (scene, camera, lighting, action) before video generation; never submits bare keywords.
- Uses WeryAI API (requires WERYAI_API_KEY, Node.js 18+).
- Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video workflows; clear API parameter checks and user confirmation required before running tasks.
- Returns playable video URLs or clear error feedback; designed to fit short-form, destruction-aesthetic/ASMR video niches.
